pkgmetadata.longdescription: Vibe-Trading is a personal AI trading agent that uses natural language to drive finance research, strategy backtesting, and live/paper trading across stocks, crypto, and futures markets. It integrates multiple data sources and LLM backends via LangChain/LangGraph.

use.flag: Enable A-share data via BaoStock TCP protocol
Enable DeepSeek LLM backend via langchain-deepseek
Enable harmonic pattern analysis via pyharmonics
Enable Interactive Brokers live trading via ib_async
